subject: Partner discovery: CloudBridge marketplace — demo ownership & next steps
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Rao <amit.rao@cloudbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Hi Hannah / Camila —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Really appreciate the clarity on Redwood's dedicated/private options and the routing/fallback story — that resonated with our cloud GTM team. High-level recap from our side: 

- Primary use case: CloudBridge wants a private, co-sell listing in the marketplace that can present Redwood-hosted inference endpoints but allow our enterprise customers to bring their own VPC connectors.
- Main technical asks: VPC onboarding checklist, an architecture diagram for the marketplace flow, and a short demo showing how model variants + fallbacks behave under burst traffic.
- Commercial notes: CloudBridge is targeting a Q4 marketplace launch; initial set of 5 pilot customers.

Next step ask: we'd like to schedule a partner-led technical deep-dive/demo focused on the marketplace integration and operational handoff. Suggested attendees: 
- From CloudBridge: Amit (integration lead), Priya (partnerships)
- From Redwood: someone from infra/serving runtime, an alliances/partner lead, and optionally a sales rep for GTM alignment.

Can you propose 2–3 slots for next week (US mornings / Europe afternoons would be ideal)? I'm attaching a high-level capabilities PDF that Amit referenced in the call.

Attachments: CloudBridge_Marketplace_Capabilities.pdf

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.

Priya Shah
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge
priya@cloudbridge.ai
mobile: +1 415-555-0119

---

(Please include any calendar/Doc links in replies — we’ll circulate an internal pre-read once slot is locked.)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@cloudbridge.ai>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@cloudbridge.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + next steps from today's partner discovery

Hi Priya / Amit —

Great to e-meet — thanks for the recap and the PDF. Confirming we’ll own the next-step coordination from Redwood’s side. Short answers up front: yes to a partner-led technical deep-dive, and we’ll bring our infra lead and a solutions engineer.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 20 Jul, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 21 Jul, 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu 22 Jul, 13:00–14:00 PT (Europe-friendly)

If none of these work, tell us a couple of times that do and we’ll try to accommodate. Proposed agenda attached (demo-agenda-slate.docx) — it includes a short environment checklist so we can run a short live test if you can provide a sandbox tenant or temporary API keys.

Participants from Redwood (tentative):
- Hannah Schmitt — Alliances (owner)
- Camila Reyes — Partner Solutions (lead for GTM/PS handoff)
- Ben Carter — Solutions Engineering (demo & architecture)
- Additional: infra engineer (TBD)

Action items for CloudBridge before the call:
- Confirm preferred slot
- Share any sandbox credentials or a short list of the pilot customer profiles you want us to demo against

Attachments: demo-agenda-slate.docx

Thanks — I’ll hold the Tue/Wed/Thu slots on my calendar pending confirmation.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Alliances Manager | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Office: +1 650-555-0264
